message.content: An editorial illustration features a man in profile, facing right, wearing a light gray uniform with two gold stars on a red and black shoulder patch. A black mask hangs from his right ear. He has a wide smile and holds a black smartphone in both hands. His right thumb rests on the screen, while his left hand is clenched in a fist. The smartphone displays a text message conversation with "Heryanty Akidi Tio" showing a message: "Selamat! Anda mendapatkan dana bantuan sebesar Rp 2 Triliun." Above him, the word "TEMPO" is written in large white serif letters, with "50 Tahun!" in white script below. Smaller text at the top reads "KEMATIAN COVID DI PELOSOK DESA" and "PENELITI INDONESIA PEMBUAT VAKSIN ASTRAZENECA." To the right, bold black text reads "PRANK DUA TRILIUN," followed by a paragraph in smaller black font. The background is solid yellow. A red border runs along the left and bottom edges. The bottom right corner contains a barcode, a QR code, and publication details dated "9-15 AGUSTUS 2021."
